description: The pie chart, titled "Modality Distribution," illustrates the proportion of different audio modalities within the MMAR benchmark dataset. The chart is divided into seven distinct segments, each representing a specific modality and its corresponding percentage of the total. The largest segment is "Speech," which accounts for 29.4% of the data and is colored in a medium purple. The second largest is "Mix-Sound-Speech," at 21.8%, shown in a lighter lavender. "Music" makes up 20.6% and is represented by a slightly darker purple than "Mix-Sound-Speech." "Sound" comprises 16.5% and is depicted in a very light lavender. "Mix-Music-Speech" constitutes 8.2% and is colored in a deep purple. "Mix-Sound-Music" accounts for 2.4% and is shown in a medium light purple. The smallest segment is "Mix-Sound-Music-Speech," at 1.1%, which is the lightest shade of purple and is visually emphasized by being slightly separated from the rest of the pie. Each segment is clearly labeled with its modality name and percentage value, and the chart uses a color gradient from light to dark purple to differentiate the categories.
